cut: Final consumer v3, read-only codegen qualification; timing interpretation belongs to root
scope: 144 complete roots, six final local consumer ELFs, four arms, scalar/N4/N8 and full/tail. A6/B2 hierarchy. Local generic ARM only; no native-target qualification.

source.compiler: Clang21; ARMv8-A+SIMD/generic; O3; automatic loop and SLP vectorizers disabled; no LTO. Exact commands are preserved per case.

methods: Select complete read<N,Tail,Body> symbols at production A6/B2
Check every root for BL/BLR/BR and external B
Stream equivalence preserves every mnemonic, register and immediate; only branch targets are normalized relative to the root
Charge fixed stack from actual SP subtraction plus predecrement save area; exclude transitive/concurrent peak claims

mechanism.finding: All full checksum and callback wrappers now fuse, as do tail consumers. No TuplePack or SeriesPack primitive calls, or StreamPack each_bytes calls, remain. The v1/v2 outlines are eliminated.
mechanism.qualification: Static qualification only. Full and tail consumers require different payload work and produce different code.

mechanism.finding: Direct isolates field transfers and shares hierarchy routing, layout and bag policy. All 36 final composed/Direct pairs have identical instructions, registers and immediates after normalizing only branch targets relative to each root.
mechanism.qualification: This is not independent routing or whole-image/timing equivalence.

mechanism.finding: K40/W64 map primary, secondary and overflow tail paths converge on one 8-byte final-payload load. No full 64-byte payload scratch or copy survives.
mechanism.qualification: The admitted 16-byte selector windows at bucket+5 and bucket+9 incidentally read the first 11 payload bytes in each one-slot bucket. Direct pays the same access.

mechanism.finding: K40/W64 MM stores a 16-byte index head/hint payload plus tag. Inline capacity is 16/64 = 0, so values live in external bags. Final scalar/N4/N8 paths retain an 8-byte head chunk plus tag; only the low 32-bit head is used. Four unused hint bytes within that chunk survive; the remaining eight index payload bytes disappear.
mechanism.qualification: This is not a 64-byte inline value copy. Final scalar lowering differs from the v1 4-byte head load.

mechanism.finding: Each MM bag value has one 8-byte tail load with a 64-byte stride. No full-value materialization or callback boundary survives.
mechanism.qualification: Encoded head, owner block, format binding, data address, linked next/count and iteration still execute. Abseil InlinedVector<value64B,1> uses its inline/allocated pointer and length. This is an observed topology difference, without cycle/cache attribution.

mechanism.finding: Packet roots retain hash-fact and owner staging/spills. Call-free does not mean stack-free. The whole 24-byte answer uses ARM X8 once per complete trace, not a per-key result buffer.

API_implications: The visible selected-field consumer eliminates full-value copies through record construction. This evidence does not justify an extra field API solely to remove a suspected 64-byte copy.
Fusion must cover the complete callback chain. Outer forced-inline APIs did not prevent the v1 benchmark wrappers or v2 promoted record wrapper from outlining; v3 qualifies the actual complete roots.
This result applies to visible, nonsuspending native consumers. It does not establish universal elimination across erased, separate-TU or suspending consumers.
W64 MM external-bag ownership is a consequential independent policy versus Abseil inline-one storage. The transfer-isolation control shares this policy and cannot remove it.

previous_cuts.qualification: V1 was a timed diagnostic with outlines. V2 was build-only and never timed. V3 is bound to both final timing cohorts. Wrapper attributes also change scalar tail registers, frames and head-load lowering; v1-to-v3 is not isolated call removal.

limits: Reviewer performed no builds, timings, source edits, MCA or native jobs
No hardware cycle, cache or peak-throughput inference from instructions
Full assembly and symbol catalogs remain ignored; recover through exact timed ELFs and the source capture
The bundle contains selected complete bodies; all 144 root extents/hashes are indexed. Verbose symbols remain in ignored roots.json
